title: National Merit Scholarship Scheme 2024-25
raw_notice_text:
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION & HIGHER LEARNING
CENTRAL SCHOLARSHIP CELL
NOTICE NO. ED/2024/SCH/891
Date: 10th October 2024

SUBJECT: APPLICATIONS INVITED FOR NATIONAL MERIT SCHOLARSHIP 2024-25

1. PURPOSE:
Financial assistance of Rs. 24,000 per annum for meritorious undergraduate students from economically weaker sections.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
Students enrolled in regular 1st or 2nd year degree courses who secured at least 75% marks in Class 12th board exams with annual parental income below Rs. 2,50,000.

3. LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION:
The portal will strictly close on 15th November 2024 at 11:59 PM IST. Late submissions will be rejected without exception.

4. MANDATORY DOCUMENTS REQUIRED:
Applicants must submit self-attested copies of:
- Class 12 Marksheet
- Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar
- Valid College ID Card
- Bank Passbook Copy (Aadhaar linked)

5. APPLICATION FEE:
No application fee is required for this scholarship scheme. Applying is completely free.

6. HELP DESK & INQUIRIES:
For any clarification, contact scholar-cell@gov.edu.in or call 011-23384501 during working hours (10 AM - 5 PM).
